response.sql:
WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT powerstatus,
         telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The average share across statuses is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the distinct powerstatus groups, including the NULL group.
